title: Respect browser, account and staff consent in analytics collection

source.ref: Owner analytics dashboard and user-flow request, 2026-11-13.

detail: Consenting browser activity is collected only after trusted audience resolution; client-supplied GA identity and authority flags cannot bypass the public collector. Browser identity comes from consented cookies, and private URL/title content is removed. New focused regressions failed before implementation; existing probes remain unchanged. Implementation proof does not assert production activation. CI trace 43522750456 identified excessive generic RPC receiver-binding instantiation. The existing gems signature is applied before binding, and both admin and session client factories preserve the full SDK RPC signature through receiver-only binding. Emitted JavaScript is identical, and direct/bound RPC names and required arguments remain checked. The complete sixteen-site inventory contains twelve admin-client sites, two generated-schema session-client message readers, one type-erased ticket client and one already-narrow test client. Targeted admin-consumer instantiations drop from 3597768 to 69469; the first session reader drops from 3597626 to 69415. Post-fix trace 43528206975 confirms progress beyond the old hot paths while the whole program still exhausts the 6 GiB V8 allocation. CI provisions an 8 GiB Typecheck process heap only after measuring at least 12 GiB of effective physical/cgroup runner capacity, and records peak RSS with time -v. The complete tsc verification, all acceptance checks, local/lint allocation, tests, probes and production artifact budgets are unchanged.
